body:
Add Cursor-documented hook depth that siblings approximate via SessionStart/compaction defenses and subagent control: `preCompact` re-injects active-ticket/rails reminders; `subagentStart`/`subagentStop` coordinate ADLC P5 prosecutor agents shipped in T66.

Depends on T66 agents existing (edge from T66). Prefer session_id scoping from T64 when present.

=== DELIVERABLES ===
1. `hooks/adlc-precompact.mjs` — observational; returns user_message reminding of active ticket + rails; never claims to block compaction.
2. `hooks/adlc-subagent.mjs` (or split start/stop) — allow prosecutor agent types used by /adlc-prosecute; optional deny/ask for unrelated subagents only when an active P5 marker file is set by the prosecute command (document the marker; default permissive if marker absent).
3. Wire events in hooks/hooks.json + scaffolder merge + smoke.
4. Pin contracts in ADR-0006; update matrix hook-depth notes.

=== ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA ===
- AC1: preCompact + subagentStart + subagentStop present in default plugin hooks.json. VERIFY: smoke.
- AC2: preCompact fixture test returns a message including ticket id when pointer present. VERIFY: unit test.
- AC3: Without P5 marker, subagentStart allows explore/generalPurpose (no brick). VERIFY: unit test.
- AC4: With P5 marker, start allows configured prosecutor agent names. VERIFY: unit test.
- AC5: Rails guard scripts untouched (rails).

=== OUT OF SCOPE ===
- Implementing Cursor Task tool itself.
- Fail-closed subagent policy as default (too brick-prone).
- Tab hooks.
=== P1 ===
AC12: fresh marker + unrelated subagent => ask or deny (not always-allow).

=== P1 ===
preToolUse is authoritative Task allowlist; subagentStart defense-in-depth.
T67 before T68 and T69.

=== P1 ===
Checked-in Task preToolUse + subagentStart fixtures; dispatcher cases required.

=== P1 ===
P5 marker write/delete under fenced lock; paused-cleanup barrier test.

=== P1 ===
AC12 nested Task canary under parent P5 marker.

=== P1 ===
Nested Task P5 degraded/permissive until lineage channel proven; no shared anonymous marker.


(Renumbered from T65 → T67 so main's T62/T63 fleet/hollow-test contracts stay intact for rails-guard.)
